findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_brand_card, get_subscription_options · Private data: get_todays_projections, get_performance_summary, get_track_record, get_methodology, get_model_vs_market, get_league_schedule, get_pick_history, get_premium_slate, get_premium_game_recommendation, get_player_props, get_player_prop_history, get_oracle_insights, get_market_fair_value, get_subscription_options · Public sink: get_model_vs_market, get_premium_slate, get_player_prop_history · Destructive: get_oracle_board, get_oracle_insights.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_brand_card, get_subscription_options · Private data: get_todays_projections, get_performance_summary, get_track_record, get_methodology, get_model_vs_market, get_league_schedule, get_pick_history, get_premium_slate, get_premium_game_recommendation, get_player_props, get_player_prop_history, get_oracle_insights, get_market_fair_value, get_subscription_options · Public sink: get_model_vs_market, get_premium_slate, get_player_prop_history · Destructive: get_oracle_board, get_oracle_insights

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
